[b]Uma pena que o jogo tenha sido removido da Loja Steam, porque é um jogo muito bom, ainda assim irei analisar da mesma forma.[/b]

Recomendação de um amigo em live, achei super interessante e eis que esse jogo me conquistou pra valer, em Dark Echo você testa praticamente sua percepção, atenção, cautela, tudo mais, inclusive em alguns momentos pode te causar aflição e desespero, pois quando vem coisas obscuras te perseguindo, aquilo ali deixa qualquer um tenso.

Esse jogo aqui é incrível, a esfera dele que saí de silêncio enorme para um barulho de perseguição é de uma tacada genial mesmo.

# Jogabilidade e Controle: Simples, não tem muito o que fazer, basicamente usar as setas e só.
# Gráficos: Simples também, para a premissa do jogo é até mais que o suficiente.
# Insígnias: Indisponível, visto que o jogo saiu da Loja Steam, quem fez algum nível, pode considerar uma insígnia rara.
# Conquistas: São somente 3, porém que você só vai conquistando ao finalizar cada total de fases, podendo demorar um tanto.
# Dificuldade: A dificuldade varia exatamente com o fator que falei desde o início dessa análise, algumas fases causa uma aflição, agonia, com isso pode te fazer errar um pouco e algumas fases reiniciar mais vezes que as outras, porém, ainda assim, o conceito é bom, então é bem equilibrado num geral
# História/Enredo: Nada de mais, é basicamente imersão e teoria pra quem quiser criar.

No mais, é um jogo incrível, tenso, que trabalha bastante o raciocínio. Mais uma verdadeira pena que ele tenha saído da Loja Steam.

Uma Nota Final 9.0/10.0

Dark Echo è un’esperienza horror minimalista che dimostra come il terrore possa nascere anche dal silenzio sviluppato dal team canadese RAC7, il gioco trasforma il suono in strumento di sopravvivenza, offrendo un gameplay originale, ansiogeno e profondamente immersivo.

🌑 Punti di Forza
Concept innovativo: niente grafica tradizionale, solo impronte e onde sonore. Il mondo si rivela attraverso l’eco dei tuoi passi.

Atmosfera claustrofobica: ogni livello è un labirinto invisibile, dove il buio nasconde creature mortali e il suono è la tua unica guida.

Gameplay semplice ma profondo: tocca lo schermo per muoverti, tieni premuto per fare rumore e scoprire l’ambiente. Ogni azione è strategica.

Design minimalista ed elegante: lo stile visivo è essenziale, ma estremamente efficace nel creare tensione.

Colonna sonora e effetti audio eccellenti: il suono è protagonista assoluto, capace di generare paura, suspense e orientamento.

👁️ Per chi è consigliato?
- Amanti dell’horror psicologico e dei puzzle game.

- Giocatori che cercano esperienze immersive e fuori dagli schemi.

- Chi apprezza il design sperimentale e l’uso creativo del sonoro.

💬 Opinione finale
Dark Echo è una gemma indie che dimostra come il terrore possa essere evocato con pochi elementi, ma ben calibrati un gioco che ti fa ascoltare il buio, ti costringe a pensare, e ti lascia con il fiato sospeso se cerchi un’esperienza originale e inquietante, Dark Echo è da non perdere.

[h1] A flash in the pan: the disqualification of level design behind stunning creativity [/h1]

[h2]7/10 [/h2]

[h3] Opening [/h3]

If you were denied your eyesight and placed in a strange and dangerous dungeon, how might you flee? Dark Echo, initially released for mobile phones in 2015, is one such game. Players can only judge the surrounding environment through visual echoes here, and they have to face numerous traps and ferocious beasts. The game's incredible creativity instantly attracted attention and won the honor of Apple Store's most innovative phone game of 2015. Even in the subsequent wave of Indie games, there were few with similar innovations. 

However, the level design of Dark Echo is somewhat mediocre, and the visual experience it brings to players is terrible. The overly brief game content and the horror elements it contains have also invisibly raised the threshold, causing the game to be silent for a time and fall to the point where no one cares about it. It was not until April 5, 2025, when the news that the game would be removed from Steam was announced, that it returned to the vision of many players once more, and for the last time.

[h3]Strength [/h3]

Rather than playing the role of a blind person, players in the game are likelier to experience the feeling of a bat using echolocation. In addition to moving, players can also actively make sounds by clapping and throwing stones, and infer the surrounding environment that is differentiated by different colors through visual echos, such as red traps that will cause instant death, blue water flows that make loud noises, and yellow mechanisms that could change the scene. Beasts that track any sound in the scene and various dangerous automated mechanisms are the main obstacles to the player's escape. Occasionally they appear in parallel, requiring players to formulate targeted strategies and deal with them cleverly. The game's stereo sound effects are excellent as well. Whether it's the realistic echo of the scene when moving the dull roar of the beast, or the miserable scream when the character dies, they all fully mobilize the player's imagination and bring a strong sense of immersion and tension.

[h3] Weakness [/h3]

Dark Echo claims to have more than 80 levels divided into two worlds, black and white. The white is unlocked after the player completes the game for the first time. In almost every level, faster beasts are included, but except for a few levels where the scenes are changed, most of them are similar to the back and too monotonous. The game has an increasingly high tolerance for error requirements for player operations in the middle and late levels. Though there are a few outstanding levels, the overall lack of innovation and the design is far from sophisticated likewise, especially since the game indirectly encourages players to memorize the game and the core of passing level through trial and error after death is quite bad in puzzle games. As a result, though the game levels cannot be said to be difficult, the actual gaming experience is quite torturous.

One of the player's main actions in the level includes luring away beasts, but their movements can completely ignore the scene terrain, significantly destroying the immersion of the game. The alternating black-and-white images are too drastic in visual change, giving players a very uncomfortable visual experience, especially in the white world. The game's UI is too simplistic, the levels where treasures are veiled are packed too tightly, there is no real-time collection progress tracking in the game, and the thriller and horror elements also keep some casual players out.

[h3] Conclusion [/h3]

The creativity of Dark Echo is amazing, but the lack of game content and monotonous level design have failed to maximize its capabilities, and it will inevitably be a flash in the pan. The removal of it from Steam was quite a gimmick, but may also be regarded as the swan song, allowing it, which was previously more of a distant memory of many players on mobile games, to shine for the last time. 

In general, Dark Echo is a lightweight puzzle game. Its only highlight is the visualization of sound for exploration. The game process is not long and is very suitable for experiencing in leisure time, but it does not have the charm to attract players to play it multiple times. It is worth mentioning that this game essentially visualizes sounds as game images, so it is inappropriate for visually impaired players.

[h3]Live. Die. Repeat.[/h3] 
Как бы это ни прозвучало, но игра раскрывается ближе к середине-концу — и цветёт пышным цветом в light-режиме, открывающемся после первого прохождения. Представляет он из себя усложнённую версию всех сорока уровней с сохранённой геометрией, но более опасными содержимым, т.е. дополнительными [усиленными] врагами и неприятными препятствиями. 

Это блестящий образчик минимализма и достойный представитель стелс-жанра (в популярных метках, кстати, не указано). Что касается хоррора, так пугают не столько чудовища, сколько внезапные смерти в кромешной тьме. 

Единственная механика, которую я всё не мог осознать, это [spoiler]движущиеся стены[/spoiler], и ответ пришлось искать на форуме; происходит сие без звуков по типу «[i]вжжухх[/i]», «[i]шшух[/i]», «[i]бдым[/i]» или какого-либо автономного визуального сопровождения, так что я долго думал, что персонаж бесшумно скатывается со скользкой горочки, вследствие чего пазл никак не решался. 

Что же до антуража, так мне нравится представлять, что место действия — древнеегипетская гробница, а «монстры» вполне могут оказаться метафорическим изображением панического страха.

Пришла новость, что скоро эту игру нельзя будет приобрести в магазине, поэтому это может быть последний шанс приобрести её. 

Сама игра построена вокруг очень интересной идеи с игровым процессом на основе распространяющихся звуковых волн, что используется для создания набора уровней не связанных особо сюжетной линией. Некоторые уровни получились неудачными. Например, тот в котором тебя преследует непонятный объект и его надо обойти. Или уровень, в котором комната наполнена передвигающимися механизмами. Решения у таких уровней были не очевидными и вместо удовлетворения вызывали раздражение. Однако в других частях игры механика работала отлично, и игре удавалось быть страшной. По итогу, потенциал игровой механики был реализован, пускай и не в полной мере. Игра при этом довольно короткая, все достижения можно получить за пару часов, но и стоимость её довольно низкая. Поэтому я определённо рекомендую приобрести игру и опробовать её самостоятельно, пока есть возможность.

This game portrays me on the kitchen at 3 AM

Jokes aside, I had previously played this on mobile, but it seems to have been removed from the store so I decided to give it a try on steam

As it often occurs to indie games, the idea sounds brilliant but the reality is frustrating. The basic concept itself is amazing, but its graphical style is obviously very simple, which normally should be made up for in gameplay, which is not the case for this game. Gotta give credit for sound design, since it's really decent, though that doesn't matter that much when game exhausts all of it diversity in less than an hour.

The main thing I noticed was that all the interactions seem really sluggish, not only to give it a slow and unnerving tempo, but also making it feel like the game is stretched thin. It is also very short (<4 hours) and I'd say there is no replayability apart from locating all secrets.

You probably shouldn't listen to me since that was my humble opinion, but you'll never know until you try, even though I found myself quite frustrated with it.

记得在小学，吃完午饭的慵懒的午间，我后桌的同学带了手机，在午休的时候打开了这个游戏，别人也凑过来问“这是什么游戏，”叫“回声探路”。温暖的阳光通过薄薄的窗帘照在桌子上，我们靠着窗台下的阴凉在手机上彳亍。我们为被红色的未知追杀而懊恼，也为了发现长按与短按的操作不同而惊喜，也为闯关成功而开心。虽然只玩了短短十几二十分钟，大部分时间我也是旁观者，仅打通前几关，但童年那纯粹的快乐，那份对世界好奇的探索永存。后面他好像没带过手机，我也再想他什么时候可以给我一次机会探索一番，后来我也逐渐忘了这个游戏。
直到我又在steam上发现。让我想起那段美好的回忆。
